timer.name: netflix_a_page_browse
timer.description: Runs while the row observer's pages are shown: the Movies/Shows root in Videos, or My Lists.

timer.name: netflix_a_page_tab
timer.description: Runs while Videos is on a tab page (Movies/Shows root, a watchlist, Saved) or on a genre page other than the genre menu's.

timer.name: netflix_movies_landing
timer.description: Enter Movies once the technical Home window is ready, without loading Home shelves.

timer.name: splashtest_autotime
timer.description: Advance the splash preview by one hour every three seconds.

timer.name: netflix_search_grid_reset
timer.description: Search grid focused, its results finished loading for a query other than the one its cursor belongs to: back to item 1.

timer.name: netflix_refocus
timer.description: R10.2: the Videos window's delayed refocus after load (was two AlarmClock SetFocus calls), done only if the viewer is not on the top bar, in the genre list, in a tab arrival or a tab dwell by now (the Shows refocus also only while focus is still nowhere or on the hidden 591: the row observer may have placed it already); dropped otherwise.

timer.name: netflix_tab_dwell
timer.description: Fallback only (R10.2): dialog 1158 opens the dwelled tab after 100 ms; this opens it if 1158 has not after 1 s, and drops a dwell whose tab lost focus.

timer.name: netflix_tab_arrival
timer.description: Expire a cancelled header handoff.

timer.name: netflix_saved_shelf_focus
timer.description: Move from a focused loading placeholder into its populated shelf. R10.22: also from the opened list's / See All's stand-in (8534 / 8535) onto the remembered poster (the first one; the one it had when a player parked the list) or tile, onto Rename for an empty list, and from a parked list (Netflix.MyLists.Loaded.list cleared while 534 had focus) back to the stand-in.

timer.name: netflix_continue_gone
timer.description: R10.5: focus on an emptied Continue Watching row (594 Movies, 595 Shows) moves to Trending, else the tab.

timer.name: netflix_cw_remember_594
timer.description: R10.12: Continue Watching row 594 has titles: remember it, so the next load shows grey cards (Netflix.CW.WasFull.594).

timer.name: netflix_cw_forget_594
timer.description: R10.12: row 594 finished loading and is empty: forget it (no grey cards next time).

timer.name: netflix_cw_remember_595
timer.description: R10.12: Continue Watching row 595 has titles: remember it, so the next load shows grey cards (Netflix.CW.WasFull.595).

timer.name: netflix_cw_forget_595
timer.description: R10.12: row 595 finished loading and is empty: forget it (no grey cards next time).

timer.name: netflix_catalog_genre_focus
timer.description: Transfer focus only while the loaded genre placeholder still has focus.

timer.name: netflix_browse_start
timer.description: Start the row observer on its pages (netflix_a_page_browse, top of this file) when it is not running.

timer.name: netflix_browse_watchdog
timer.description: Healthy heartbeats update properties; launch Python only after five unchanged seconds.

timer.name: netflix_genre_menu_arrival
timer.description: Adopt a genre-menu route once Videos shows it; drop an unanswered request after 45 seconds.

timer.name: netflix_genre_menu_guard
timer.description: Close a drawer whose window or focus is gone; drop menu-grid state once a tab page replaces it.

timer.name: netflix_genre_menu_hop
timer.description: Grid Back parks focus on 3736 and reopens the drawer; once the drawer has had a visibility pass, move focus to the remembered genre row.

timer.name: netflix_genre_menu_park
timer.description: Grace clock for a parked grid-Back drawer: 3 seconds for the hop to land, then close it with focus on the visible menu button.

timer.name: netflix_back_twice_open
timer.description: R10.29: a double Back asked for the Video add-ons list. From Movies / Shows: the same Videos window with the add-ons path and "return" (Kodi keeps the path history: its Back goes to the ChadFlix path). From My Lists: Videos first (its ChadFlix path, history intact), remember that path, then the same. Away is set right after the activation (review F1: a Back within the first 0.5 s still returns), Cool from now until about 1 s after the return (F5).

timer.name: netflix_back_twice_return
timer.description: R10.29: Videos is back on the ChadFlix path the add-ons list was opened from. While focus is still on the view (591 / 500, or 592: on the Shows swap Kodi's hidden 591 hands focus to Shows Trending 592) (keys pressed in the gap win, review F3): focus the control the double Back came from, or reopen My Lists (kept in memory, rows loaded) on its tab. R10.29.1: it runs only once some control has focus (so never "nowhere") and after Videos' own refocus; the My Lists reopen also runs while focus is on the page's tab 3732 / 3733 (a Back mashed in the gap moves focus from the row to that tab; the viewer is still on the way back to My Lists). Always: forget the return, and end the cool-down about 1 s from now.
